newsitem.title: UK: Austria prices 5.0 billion FRF seven-year Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Austria prices 5.0 billion FRF seven-year Eurobond.

text.p: Austria has priced its structured 5.0 billion French franc seven-year Eurobond, joint lead managers CDC and J.P. Morgan said on Monday.
